The change makes `create_model` call `define_secant_loss_constraints(n, sns[1:], ...)` instead of passing the full `sns`. For a network using secant transmission-loss constraints with a nonempty snapshot horizon, that constraint builder now receives a horizon missing its first snapshot, including under legacy semantics with the default, `"auto"`, or `"multiindex"` setting.
